notes.title: Big update and release plans!
notes.content:
It's been a while since last update.

[h1]Most important thing![/h1]
The game is ready in 98% and the release is scheduled for August (the second half )! Fingers crossed!

[h1]Localization[/h1]
The game has already been translated into German, French, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese. They are up and running. Spanish is in progress. We are also planning to make Japanese but it's a though one.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/ba8ff31bed320ae73380f457e6e73f38dcdf6a5c.png[/img]

[h1]Steam achievements[/h1]
We've added over 30 achievements and still counting. There will be probably around 40 of them.

[h1]Gamepad support and keyboard[/h1]
That one is very important and a lot of you asked for it. We've added full controller support (both Xbox an PS). It's amazing how much the gameplay has changed. Playing this king of games on a keyboard is a real torture :).
We've also added full in-menu keyboard (and gamepad) navigation so you don't need to use the mouse if don't want to.
image.png
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/ce898bea03d1419679fe40e617c21920e3e1df52.png[/img]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
We've recently change completely 2 levels because we weren't satisfied with them and now all levels are done.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/5f4893c07c2f1be44c79b8af2f91836eddab5d21.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixing[/h1]
With a professional QA team great help we've found and fixed more than 150 bugs and glitches so the game is even more polished.

[h1]Multiplayer (that one is sad)[/h1]
Unfortunately we have to postpone multiplayer mode :(. 
The plan was to made it with other company's help. It turned out that creating it is much more complicated that they (and we) thought, would cost a lot more and we cannot afford it now. We've tried to make it on our own but Escape Doodland is our first game and our skills are not good enough yet. However, it's not a very bad news because the game will be cheaper :).

Cheers!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We are closer and closer to the release! We should be ready to go in less than 2 months.
We've recently added a  gamepad controller support and  Steam achievement system.
Now we are polishing underwater levels and making good progress. 

Stay tuned!
